# Artificial handoff controls

These invented records exercise exact AIRR text transfer, identifiers, numerical extensions,
partial/unknown annotations and unavailable sequences. They are not measured receptors, a
biological generative model, synthesis candidates or evidence of binding. Protein-like sequences
are illustrative fragments: the declared complete_vdj field is a supplied annotation, not an
independent validation of V(D)J coverage or full-protein completeness. No public search is run
for these records during validation. The native receiver exercise intercepts that request.

Only rows 1 and 2 satisfy the bounded, unchanged canonical-AA query contract. Missing, stopped,
ambiguous and lowercase sequences remain inspectable and are refused without repair. Identifiers,
including leading zeroes and expression-like punctuation, must not appear in the search command.
